description: This file defines a utility object 'JpegSizeLimiter' that provides a method for compressing JPEG images to a specified maximum byte size by adjusting image quality and dimensions. It also includes a result data class to store the compression outcome.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of JPEG size limiting, including the compressed byte array, dimensions, and quality used.

methods.name: compressToLimit
methods.description: Compresses an image to not exceed a maximum byte size by adjusting quality and dimensions through iterative scaling and quality reduction.
